messages:
maria: Heads-up — spotted a weird billing noise on the March invoice for accel usage in us-west2. Two 'support' style lines for the same time window.
ben-infra: Ugh, ok can you paste the exact line items and invoice id?
zoe-eng: Invoice: INV-2026-03-9987
zoe-eng: Here are the two lines I see:
```
SKU: AUX-ACC-SUP-01   Description: Accelerator support surcharge  2026-03-12T12:00Z  1.00 USD
SKU: ACC-SUPPORT-ALT  Description: Accel support (legacy)        2026-03-12T12:00Z  1.00 USD
```
maria: Both for the same 12:00–13:00 hour, same project tag, different SKU codes. Net charge looks doubled but amounts are tiny — still want to understand source before we chalk it up to vendor UI confusion. :thinking_face:
aj: Any recent migrations or SKU renames in the account? sounds like a transitional mapping issue.
ben-infra: We did run the regional fallback last week — moved some reserved capacity between billing accounts for failover testing. Might have triggered a pro-rated support fee on both the old and new SKU.
zoe-eng: I checked host tags — the instances were moved but both the old reservation and the new short-term allocation are referenced in the billing metadata for that hour.
maria: Can finance-bot show linked allocation ids? @cloud-billing-bot any quick lookup?
cloud-billing-bot: Found two linked allocations for project:redwood-inference-prod in us-west2 between 2026-03-12T11:45Z and 2026-03-12T13:15Z — allocation A123 (reserved) and B789 (ephemeral failover). Both carried support surcharge tags. Filing ticket with provider.
ben-infra: That matches. Looks like provider attached support fee to both reservation and ephemeral allocation when a migration overlaps. We should see a credit once vendor reconciles.
maria: Filed internal ticket FIN-INV-345 with attached CSV and provider case ref (CASE-2026-734). Tagging @aj for impact estimate.
aj: Impact is tiny on that hour, but if this happened across the whole failover window it could sum. Recommend adding a short runbook: when migrating reservations, coordinate a 15-min blackout window to avoid overlapping billable tags.
zoe-eng: Agreed. Also propose we update our provisioning script to clear support tag on ephemeral allocations while migrating.
maria: Confirmed vendor issued provisional credit yesterday (CASE-2026-734). They say root cause is duplicate surcharge attribution during reservation reassignment. Will monitor next billing cycle. :white_check_mark:
ben-infra: Thanks folks. I'll open an infra PR for the provisioning script change and paste sequence to the ticket.
maria: Closing thread once next invoice shows credit applied.
